identificationModule.briefTitle: Docetaxel, Doxorubicin (A), Cyclophosphamide (C) (TAC) vs 5-Fluorouracil, A, C (5FAC) Breast Cancer Adjuvant Treatment
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Randomized Comparing Docetaxel, Doxorubicin and Cyclophosphamide (TAC) vs 5-Fluorouracil, Doxorubicin and Cyclophosphamide (FAC) as Adjuvant Treatment of High Risk Operable Breast Cancer Patients With Negative Axillary Lymph Nodes

armGroups.label: Arm A: FAC
armGroups.description: FAC (5-fluorouracil, doxorubicin, cyclophosphamide): 5-fluorouracil 500 mg/m2 iv on day 1, each 3 weeks, in combination with doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 iv and cyclophosphamide 500 mg/m2 iv

armGroups.label: Arm B: TAC
armGroups.description: TAC (docetaxel, doxorubicin, cyclophosphamide): Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 iv on day 1, each 3 weeks, in combination with doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 iv and cyclophosphamide 500 mg/m2 iv
